title: New default UI/UX settings, improvements and fixes
body: ``` { "nebula.level": 0.5, "nebula.speed": 0.5, "nebula.gas": 0.35, "nebula.hue": 25, "nebula.stars": 1.2, "nebula.starBrightness": 0.8, "nebula.twinkle": 0.3, "nebula.vignette": 0.3, "grid.size": 48, "grid.period": 109, "rain.level": 0.75, "rain.step": 105, "rain.speeds": 2, "rain.density": 0.5, "rain.fade": 0.075, "rain.lineWidth": 1, "rain.glow": 4, "rain.glowColor": "#00a3d7", "glass.level": 0.4, "glass.blur": 3, "glass.radius": 10 } ``` We need to double check that all settings are actually applied. Also there is missing setting for padding/margin around each symbol in matrix rain. Skin block glitches (disapars when someting else is selected) it also unaligned. And we need to double check all other aligment issues across the system. We should fully support sound design and all other configuration options from all previous issues. We need to double check that our UI will be polished and in all places. If you do questionable design changes, which you are not sure will be liked by humans, add more fine grained settings. I still think https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/issues/13 was not fully delivered, and not all UI options were delivered. We need more configuration for background drawing with configurable levels. And for each layer of background we should have detailed settings, for example some other UI/UX solutions use different shapes for drawing stars and so on. And even for dots we should be able to fully configure the point (circle) size its color, color of glow and so on, we should also allow some effects that go vertically and horizontally, i don't know how they named, and also different shapes of starts and so on. We should also be able to use different number of stars background to be put on top of each other, so it will be possible to configure any artistic vision imagenable. We also need to optimize loading of all graphics for default options and also script so our website loads fast even in mobile internet. And we should be able to check it looks perfectly in all screens and so on. For futuristic angled view we must add lots of different configurations for borders, may be we want some corners to have missing borders like it is now, may be we want different shapes of cuts, or rounded corners, each corner must be configurable with selection tiles which do have a preview of such corners. We should put alot of care and options in this, so it fully configurable and we have ability also to have multiple presets, saved and so on. As we later may use these UI/UX configurations to make unified engine for all our UI related projects, so we must do even better we did in https://github.com/konard/immortality We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
